title: Property Credit Carried by a Hotel Rate Plan
content:
Property credit is the credit a rate plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range includes for use at the property against charges taken there during the stay.

**Clauses no longer in force.** The clause reading "Property credit included in the rate plan is placed on the reservation at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay and not per night" is no longer in force, and so is the clause reading "The credit lapses at the end of the plan's validity term counted from the arrival date, and whatever is unspent at departure is forfeited without payment". Both are superseded by the current bases on which the credit placed at arrival and the credit released at the close of a stay are worked out. The clauses below stand as clauses in force.

**When credit may be spent.** Property credit is spent only while the reservation record stands at checked in. The reservation record is the authority for that standing, and the spending is recorded against the reservation the record identifies; where the record stands at reserved, confirmed, checked out, cancelled, no-show or closed, the condition is not met.

**What credit may be spent on.** The credit is spent against charges taken at the property during the stay and against nothing else; it is never spent on the room rate, on taxes or on the agency service fee.

**Who may spend it.** Where the plan allows it, a companion sharing the room may spend the credit; otherwise only the lead guest may.

**Plans that carry none.** A plan whose credit amount is zero grants no credit at all, and no credit is ever granted twice on one reservation.

*Points of judgement.* *A guest whose record stands at checked out asks to put a spa charge against the credit.* The record no longer stands at checked in, so the condition for spending is not met. *A companion on a plan that does not allow transfer asks to use the credit.* Only the lead guest may spend it on that plan. *A guest asks whether the credit may be set against the room rate.* It may not; the credit covers charges taken at the property alone.

superseded_clauses: Property credit included in the rate plan is placed on the reservation at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay and not per night.
The credit lapses at the end of the plan's validity term counted from the arrival date, and whatever is unspent at departure is forfeited without payment.
